text: Nora: 🚧 quick check on the bulk-invite modal for org admins. two decisions: where to show SSO enforcement (inline toggle vs settings reference) and how to surface an audit-log shortcut after a large batch invite. attaching sketches in thread. Ibrahim: goal alignment? are we prioritizing clarity for compliance or speed for admins who do repeated batches? Nora: both, ideally. compliance requires SSO to be an org-level policy (no exceptions), but admins want minimal clicks when inviting many users. current mock had a toggle in the modal header; feels heavy. Leah: accessibility flag: putting an interactive toggle high in the modal header can be skipped by keyboard users if tab order isn't explicit. recommend a read-only status chip in the modal and a link to org SSO settings, plus an accessible tooltip describing enforcement. Jon: implementation thought: render read-only chip as a link with role="status" and tabindex=0 so it's keyboard reachable. deep-link to /orgs/:orgId/settings#sso and set focus to the SSO panel on navigation. sample: ``` SSO required ``` Ibrahim: UX concern — admins might expect to change SSO per-invite if it's visible in the modal. since legal forbids per-invite overrides, copy needs to be explicit. Nora: agreed. copy proposal: "SSO required — managed in Organization settings" (short) and tooltip explanation: "SSO is enforced for this organization. To update, go to Organization settings." Leah: aria note: tooltip must be focusable and announced. use aria-describedby on the chip pointing to an offscreen explanatory region. also ensure color contrast >= 4.5:1 for the chip text and that the info icon has accessible name. Jon: technical note: avoid heavy animations when switching to settings via deep link; screen readers need immediate focus. We'll add ?highlight=sso param to the settings URL and call focus() on the SSO heading. Ibrahim: layout suggestion — place the chip left of the modal title with a small info icon. reduce header height so it doesn't push content down on small viewports. give chip a min-width so it doesn't collapse on narrow screens. Leah: keyboard flow tests I'd like: tab through header items first, open tooltip with Enter/Space, confirm tooltip is in DOM and read by NVDA/VoiceOver, then Tab to audit-link in footer. Also add a skip-to-audit link at the top of the modal for SR users who want to jump. Nora: for the audit shortcut: add a footer link "View invite activity" that navigates to /orgs/:orgId/audit?filter=invites. opens in same tab. also plan to append audit metadata to each batch invite event: include "SSO: required" as a field so rows are self-explanatory. Jon: I'll prototype the HTML/CSS and wire the deep-link focus behavior. will include a11y attributes and a small Cypress keyboard test. CI-Bot: build queued for branch feat/bulk-invite-sso-chip at 2105557010 — https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/2345 Nora: thanks team. next steps: Jon to push prototype -> QA with keyboard+screen reader checks -> short usability with two admins. one microcopy change: security prefers the stronger verb "required" not "enforced" so use "SSO required" across UI and audit notes. Leah: confirm aria-label matches. Leah: confirmed. match visible text to aria-label. also include hidden description for screen readers: "Single sign-on is required for this organization; changes must be made in Organization settings." Ibrahim: will update mock and send new PNGs. small visual tweak: chip typeface at 13px looks cramped with 6px vertical padding on mobile; bump to 14px and 8px padding. Jon: noted. PR will include CSS vars for chip sizing and a test plan. ETA EOD. Nora: great. we'll validate on staging and schedule a short runbook for the audit log naming so SRE and compliance can parse events reliably. thanks :raised_hands:"
